name: Rulebook & interpreter
note: The rulebook language, guards, alerts, navigation and the step interpreter. Every safety claim is stated in these terms.

name: Safety properties
note: What the claims mean: receipts, waivers, alert tiers, reachability, the macro reference.

name: Hospital rules & formulary
note: Rule catalogs for each release (law, regulator, hospital policy) and drug data.

name: Clinical guarantees
note: Hard stop on signing, receipts, macros never act for a human, alert behaviour (T0–T6, A2, A4).

name: Program checker
note: The checker that admits agent-written programs and its soundness: acceptance implies the screen properties (accepted_*), plus completability.

name: Screen renderer
note: The screen tree the painter draws, and D1–D6: banner, required content, honest buttons, modal alerts.

name: UI library & geometry
note: Integer layout, layout rules G1–G10, structural certificates and the renderer-range theorem.

name: Commit reducers
note: Medication administration and ADT reducers the commit service runs.

name: Commit service protocol
note: Model of the live service: locking, retries, crashes, caches. Stated under Postgres assumptions.

name: Multi-actor models
note: Shared beds, doses given at most once, critical results escalated.

name: Clinician simulation
note: Simulated clinicians and effort measurement. Not a safety claim.

name: Research semantics
note: Exploratory boards and timelines outside the clinical runtime.

name: Programs & fixtures
note: Canonical programs and deliberately bad programs used as tests.
